segments.text:
V. 1.
The firſt Sabbath—So the Jews reckoned their Sabbaths, from the Paſſover to Pentecoſt; the firſt, ſecond, third, and ſo on, till the ſeventh Sabbath (after the ſecond Day.) This immediately preceded Pentecoſt, which was the fiftieth Day after the ſecond Day of unleavened Bread.
